errors.text: The proposed Nb-Ta-Mo-W-V composition does not reconstruct the HfNbTaTiZr Group IV-V alloy family and includes Group VI elements Mo and W.
LPBF with pre-alloyed powder is substituted for hydride-based ink extrusion, hydrogen de-binding, high-vacuum sintering, titanium oxygen gettering, and final water quenching.

The hypothesized δ-lamellae and γ″ precipitates are transferred from evidence E1 concerning a chemically distinct W-Ni-Fe-Ta alloy; no cited evidence establishes that these phases can form in Nb-Ta-Mo-W-V.
The response misses the target mechanism of sequential hydride decomposition, in-situ alloying, controlled oxygen strengthening, and quench retention of metastable beta-BCC.
It omits the silicide coating and self-healing Zr/Hf oxide mechanism required for the reported oxidation resistance.
Evidence E2 used mixed elemental powders rather than the claimed pre-alloyed powder feedstock and does not support the proposed thermo-mechanical precipitation route.
